parameters.name: configName
parameters.description: The name of the advanced configuration.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
- The type of the advanced configuration. Valid values: -ONLINE: online configuration

- -ONLINE\_CAVA: online Cava configuration

- -ONLINE\_PLUGIN: online plug-in configuration

- -ONLINE\_QUERY: query configuration

- -OFFLINE\_DICT: offline dictionary configuration

- -OFFLINE\_TABLE: offline table configuration

- -OFFLINE\_COMMON: offline configuration

- -OFFLINE\_PLUGIN: offline plug-in configuration

- -OFFLINE\_INDEX: index configuration
